An '''armsaw blade''' was an edged weapon. They were fitted on [[Eradicator E8U]], an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] owned by former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Vanel (Human)|Vanel]].
